ordering: formal authority event order, then Runtime segment projection; never Provider output order when identities disagree

field_ownership.authority_copy: copied byte-for-byte or typed projection from snapshot
field_ownership.llm_fields: read only from validated owned artifact
field_ownership.hybrid: use normalized accepted value and bind proposal provenance

conflict_detection: two writes to same owned semantic path
cas: Merge specifies expected ledger head, authority revision, exact input artifact revisions and hashes. Any mismatch rejects the whole candidate as stale; there is no partial silent overwrite.
normalization: canonical JSON first; current Markdown/PlanningDocumentIR projections are compatibility views and are reconstructed deterministically.
failure: Typed conflict/stale rejection. LLM is never called to reconcile a merge conflict.
